description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Wind/Lightning, [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Gau] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Gau
description.text: Increases [Lightning/Wind Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Lightning or Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Gau after using a Lightning or Wind ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Rage+
description.text: Six single attacks (1.20 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses (no recoil damage)

description.name: Spirit Attack: Gau
description.text: Damages the user for 25% of max HP, grants [PHY +30% Boost 3], [Quick Cast 3] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
